ManualClaimsService.#active/#revalidate require input.expectedDraftVersion to match both pinned quote and current draft; a quote cannot be silently relabelled or repriced.
currentlySupportedProtocol: After claim/reload read current /claim or /quote and /draft; retain holdId, hold.version, quote.draftVersion, pinned quote and server expiry.
Review/allocate commands use quote.draftVersion and current hold.version; no fresh saveDraft while the hold occupies the slot.

To change draft fields with existing ports: explicitly confirm release, read current draft/account context, save using fresh versions, browse again, conditionally claim again and read authoritative result. Reacquisition can lose the car; no silent restoration or second hold.
